changeRule: Preserve old scope and reasons; no dropping failed or expensive families from denominator. New families/configurations increase applicable test coverage.

tests.variations: Test every enabled transform for each applicable recipe; invalid discrete/count domains must be rejected with evidence.
tests.extraBrowserCoverage: At width1024 all enabled route/step/hint stages; full prototype and held-out journeys at768/1024.
tests.diversity: Where eligible and load-compatible pool has at least5 distinct decision structures: a10-question run includes at least5, without3 consecutive numeric-only repeats. Otherwise report availability; never expand scope silently.

sourceSafety: A benchmark citation is not a full-structure map; strict source matching is config+route specific.
